disposition: MM-C02 [AUTHORIZE] AUTHORIZED. The inert-shell implementation + proof packet is authorized; five queued interaction questions are ruled. Mid-lane owner_decision: authorizing it advances the lane to MM-C03 execution (the lane does not land here).

rulings.G1_off_canvas: CLAMP-INWARD (Blender model). The full wheel/sub-wheel repositions inward so it is entirely on-screen at viewport edges and narrow panes; no spill, no truncation. Rationale: the most proven production model; preserves the constant angular gesture vocabulary that makes marking menus work; offset-no-clamp breaks gestures at edges.
rulings.G2_timing: DUAL-MODE ratified. Delayed display at a ~280 ms hold threshold draws the wheel; an expert flick completing before the threshold executes without drawing the wheel and renders the MARK-TRAIL only. Mark-trail: KEEP (the signature expert feedback of the technique). The 280 ms figure is the standard-practice starting value, tunable later via preferences - an interaction default, NOT a PM051 performance claim.
rulings.G3_icon_in_wheel: ICON+LABEL. Icons aid expert scanning, labels preserve learnability; icon-only fails discoverability, label+key wastes the radial form.
rulings.G6_sub_wheel_width: OPTION (i) - generalize DESIGN_SPEC L429 to N-wide content-sized (the recommended option); the proven 3-wide Align case is the first instance.
rulings.F1_cardinals: RATIFY the live menu_model.json cardinal set (4-cardinal + 4-diagonal, Move at secondary NE) as canonical; DESIGN_SPEC L477's divergent per-object proposals are superseded and reconciled to the manifest through the owning evidence route.
rulings.governed_dropped_items: pan/right-button -> PM023; G5 -> PARAMETRIC_TOOLING; G4 -> counting convention. These stand as cited. All inert-shell leaves stay disabled until the verb-firing step.
rulings.prototype_refresh: AUTHORIZED as a separate Claude-prototype action (frontend-dev-01, after this gate's transition lands): bring context-menu-marking-menu.html current - fix the three unsupported depictions (4-wide Align sub-wheel -> live overflow-linear reality; even-6 Move-on-cardinal -> manifest 4+4 layout; wedge icon sizing per the G3 icon+label ruling) and depict the G2 dual-mode timing. One pass, Claude prototype lane.
